name: When should I call a professional for black spots on my ceiling?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for black spots on my ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for black spots on your ceiling if the affected area is larger than a few square feet, if you suspect the spots are due to a hidden water leak, or if you or your family members are experiencing health issues potentially related to mold. Professionals have the expertise and equipment to safely identify the mold, address the moisture source, contain the spread, and remove it effectively without causing further contamination. Attempting to clean large mold infestations yourself can be ineffective and potentially dangerous.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if black spots cover a large area, you suspect a hidden leak, or health issues arise. Professionals safely identify, remove, and prevent mold spread.
